name: rime-vscode
description: Strict Luau static checking via the rime CLI

enumDescriptions: Long-lived `rime lsp` server: warm state, check-on-type, quick fixes.
Run `rime check --format json .` per save (tier-1 fallback).
rime.mode.description: How the extension talks to rime. Reload the window after changing.

rime.checkOnSave.description: (spawn mode only) Run rime check over the workspace when a .luau/.lua file is saved.

rime.watchFiles.description: (spawn mode only) Also re-check when .lua/.luau files, rime.toml, a Rojo project file (*.project.json) or .luaurc change on disk outside the editor (git checkout, Rojo, another editor).

rime.debounceMs.description: Wait this long after the last save/file change before running rime, so a burst of changes becomes one run (spawn mode), or the server's own debounce window (lsp mode, passed at startup — reload the window after changing). A check still running when a new change lands is killed and restarted.
